title: Orphan Games: Master System + Game Gear in the FPGA
summary: The Sega Master System and Game Gear rebuilt in the FPGA: the T80 Z80, the SMS picture chip (VDP) and the SN76489 sound chip in hardware (MiSTer's SMS core, GPL-2.0-or-later, turned into Verilog with GHDL, plus jt89 by Jose Tejada, GPL-3). Play free homebrew SMS and Game Gear games from the browser (keyboard or a USB gamepad) or on an ORPHAN Remote (CYD) screen. Carts up to 128 KB with the Sega mapper. by JMSCNC, makers of RotatoCAM.

slots.1: Master System / Game Gear (cart, frame buffer, sound, pads)
